description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenClaw project, specifically testing the skill bin trust resolution and auto-allow functionalities. It defines a test suite struct with multiple test methods that simulate executable creation and trust index validation.

classes.name: ExecSkillBinTrustTests
classes.description: A struct containing unit test functions for verifying skill bin trust index building and auto-allow logic.

methods.name: `build trust index resolves skill bin paths`
methods.description: Tests if the trust index correctly resolves skill bin paths.

methods.name: `skill auto allow accepts trusted resolved skill bin path`
methods.description: Verifies that auto-allow logic correctly accepts a trusted skill bin.

methods.name: `skill auto allow rejects same basename at different path`
methods.description: Ensures that auto-allow rejects executable paths with the same basename but different locations, maintaining security.

methods.name: makeExecutable
methods.description: Creates a temporary executable file with specified name and sets executable permissions.

methods.name: makeReport
methods.description: Constructs a dummy SkillsStatusReport with specified skill bins for testing purposes.
